round_1.name: Super Series
round_1.description: Seeds/ranks 12-14 play round robin; top team advances to Round 2.

round_2.name: Group Round
round_2.advancement: Top three from each group plus next best-placed fourth-place team across both groups advance to Super 7.

important_note: Official team groups and the final qualified 14-team field may not yet be fully published. Default simulations therefore use a clearly labelled model-seeded scenario unless an authoritative participant file is supplied. Official NRR cannot be simulated from a binary winner-only match model, so tied standings use points, wins, then pre-tournament model strength as a deterministic proxy.
